_purpose: One place that says what the live lanes have actually observed, so the contribution report joins Layer B from receipts instead of from prose. Every state here is a terminal state; NOT_EXERCISED is a state, not a blank.
_rule: A lane or a rule may only carry a supported state when this file names qualifying receipt files that exist and whose recomputed digests match. scripts/publish_source_contribution.py refuses the file otherwise, so an edit that promotes a state without adding evidence fails the suite rather than shipping.

observed_breakdown.why_not_countable_as_the_matrix: one repetition per cell cannot separate an arm effect from run-to-run variance, and its own preregistration is frozen as a PILOT
one host and one repository; 8 of 14 measured metrics have zero within-arm variance, so those metrics cannot carry a treatment signal on this corpus

acceptance_unmet: paired bootstrap confidence interval for candidate uplift
228_matrix.non_claim: A missing arm is not a low score. The absent 59 sessions are absent, and no arm ordering observed so far is reported as an effect.

230_rule_ablation.why: No candidate_minus_RCA-### arm has been executed on any host. The deterministic leave-one-rule-out deltas in evals/expected/effectiveness.json are Layer A: they decide committed fixtures, not model behaviour.
230_rule_ablation.non_claim: NOT_EXERCISED is not evidence that a rule is ineffective, and a Layer A deciding delta is not a live one.

233_source_contribution.why: Layer A mappings are derivable from evals/contract.json and are published here. Every Layer B state is inherited from 230_rule_ablation, which is NOT_EXERCISED, so no source claim can be LIVE_SUPPORTED_MAPPING yet.

235_production_like.why: No authorized consumer repository has been bound, and no canary has run in any window. The held-out corpus in evals/held-out-corpus.json is an offline audit corpus, not a production-like consumer topology.
235_production_like.non_claim: Deterministic and offline-matrix evidence says nothing about production correctness, operational stability, or rollback.
